name: Navigation features: doors, lifts and slabs in the graph
body: Engine (engine/src/navigation/NavigationMesh.nox, host/NavigationApi.nox): the graph gains features. A gate is a volume that blocks the nodes inside it while it is shut. A surface is a patch of nodes on top of a kinematic slab, available while the slab is solid and optionally fragile (a route over it costs extra, and is refused when the caller asks to avoid fragile ground). A ride is a link between the two landings of a moving platform. Nyx registers each with `lantern:::navigation:::AddGate`, `AddSurface` and `AddRide` after `Build`, and says whether it is usable with `SetFeatureAvailable`. FindPath routes around a shut gate, and when it can't it plans through it and marks the point the shut gate is in front of, so the walker can wait. Tests in engine/tests/navigation.
